conclusion: True traffic-density confounding cannot be assessed from retained artifacts.
required_artifacts: per-frame detections with site, frame, track_id, and class
or per-frame tracking states with site, frame, track_id, and class
or non-null PET trajectory JSON containing frame-level positions

proxy_analysis.interpretation: No detectable association between local PET-event clustering and PET value; this does not measure true traffic density.

publication_rule: Do not claim density-adjusted PET effects or rule out density confounding without per-frame exposure/density artifacts.
